card.name: Words right before 'each other'
card.fires_on: A verb or preposition that sits right before a reciprocal phrase like 'each other', 'one another' or 'themselves', where those words are expected next. Seen in general web text about people, cells or objects acting on one another.

modes.label: Verb before 'each other'
modes.description: A verb of interaction whose object is a reciprocal phrase.
modes.example: Shalom happens when humans stop<< killing>> each other, and therefore life's dignity

modes.label: Preposition before 'each other'
modes.description: A preposition such as with, toward or to that is followed by 'each other'.
modes.example: When cells can not communicate<< with>> each other, the result is impaired tissue

modes.label: Before 'one another' or 'themselves'
modes.description: A verb or preposition followed by 'one another' or 'themselves'.
modes.example: Schools must take reasonable steps to keep students from<< harming>> one another.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'each' (or 'each other') as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'each other' when two or more parties act on one another.
